Authorized 2026-11-03 after preliminary detection of a separate branch SX. A complete search Puzzle At this stage it is not started: first accurate historical chain, synthetic controls, measurement and complete pass decision.

  1. Don't change the sealed SXM-01/02/03. Use them toolchain, objects library CUDA only for reading, with verification SHA256 before and after.
  2. Native test build: replace only the source uint32 for new_seed, add diagnostic tracks entropy/stretch/public/MPK/sequence. Don't change RNG, SHA, indexes or arithmetic of the original version.
  3. Additional diagnostics EXE clearly compressed=false serve control Electrum-Mathematics; it is not considered historical EXE.
  4. Check it out 16 spaced uint32 seed, both receive/change, indexes 0/1/49/50, borders, leading-zero entropy, insertion LF/CRLF faulty seed. Verify with independents scalar-MT, hashlib and affine-secp256k1 models.
  5. Po Po Git-history RNG format MPK. Separately determine the suitability of private and public derivation Successful and unsuccessful controls; lack of regular assembly is not a substitute It's a random patch.
  6. CUDA measure 100000 SHA256(previous_bytes || original_hex32_ASCII). Entrance first 16 MT19937 draws %255, hex In the lower case. Check it out SHA256 padding/lengths, shortened and complete chains, native controls; then full synthetic pipeline: stretch → public X → four genpriv variantreceive/change × i-1/i), i=50, artificially target.
  7. Full domain of potential future search [0,4294967296). Synthetic pilot off-cover Puzzle; real-life/holdout Don't read. Extrapolation refers only to the measured implementation on that machine.
  8. Bottom line: history, precise bytes and constraints, controls, speed, the cost of a full pass and an explicit decision, if the model is unusable or Unjustified price does not automatically go to the brute.
